texts.facts: This suit for perpetual injunction is filed by the plaintiff for restraining infringement of trade mark/copyright, confusion, dilution, passing off, delivery up, rendition of accounts along with damages to the tune of Rs. 5,00,000/- etc. against the defendant. It was stated that Plaintiff including its predecessors, licensees, permitted users, associates and affiliates, was a well known manufacturer and trader in Tea, Elachi, and was covered under class 30 of the Trade Marks Act, 1999, and its products and services were being marketed under the Trademark 'Nova' which had been in the market for decades. Surya Marketing Co vs Smc Nova Estate Pvt. Ltd on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/92795922/ 1 Plaintiff was also stated to be the owner of NOVA (label) and had filed application for its art work and had filed TM- C vide receipt no. 2229218 dated 28.05.2019, for copyright, NOC of which was pending before the Trade Mark Registry. The aforementioned trade mark had been registered under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 since the year 2001. 6. In the light of the aforesaid facts and circumstances, the plaintiff had prayed for passing of a decree in favour of Plaintiff and against the defendant detailed as hereunder:- Surya Marketing Co vs Smc Nova Estate Pvt. Ltd on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/92795922/ 3 1) For perpetual injunction, restraining the defendant, their servants, agents, representative, dealers and all other persons on their behalf from passing off their said products of tea, Elachi thereof under the offending trade mark SMC NOVA or under any other identical with and/ or deceptively Similar trade mark as that of the plaintiff well known and well Routed trade mark NOVA in relation to their products of tea, Elachi. ii) For perpetual injuction restraining the Defendant, their servants and agents from infringing the copyright in the trade mark SMC NOVA.
